description: This Java class implements a configuration for monitoring logger settings, providing values such as capacities, maximum log size, and durations, loaded from a typesafe configuration object.

classes.name: DefaultMonitoringLoggerConfig
classes.description: Immutable implementation of MonitoringLoggerConfig holding logger configuration parameters loaded from a configuration source.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create an instance of DefaultMonitoringLoggerConfig from a Config object.

methods.name: maxLogSizeInBytes
methods.description: Returns the maximum log size in bytes.

methods.name: loggingActiveCheckInterval
methods.description: Returns the interval for active logging checks.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality with another object based on configuration values.

methods.description: Generates a hash code based on configuration values.
